meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 为 HyperFrames 合成创建可定位的关键帧动画，控制画面缩放、移动、裁剪等可见运动，并确保动画可跳转、可验证。它只管视觉运动，不处理剪辑和声音。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要镜头运动或转场等视觉效果，或需要 GSAP/CSS 关键帧，或做关键帧诊断时触发。不用于场景规划、品牌设计、字幕等。

say.text: 给这段画面做一个推近镜头，最后停在人物脸上。
say.note: Claude 会为它创建可定位的关键帧缩放动画。

say.text: 把这张图片做成缓慢平移加缩放的 Ken Burns 效果。
say.note: Claude 会生成位移和缩放关键帧并检查可跳转。

say.text: 检查这个合成的关键帧是否都能正常跳转。
say.note: Claude 会运行诊断命令并给出结果。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude author deterministic, seek-safe keyframe animation for HyperFrames compositions: zoom, pan, crop, and other visible motion, then verify it with CLI checks. It owns visual motion only, not clip assembly or audio.
howto.when_en: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs camera-style motion, GSAP/CSS keyframes, or keyframe diagnostics. Not for scene strategy, branding, sourcing, etc.

say_en.text: Add a punch-in to this clip, ending on the person's face.
say_en.note: Claude will create a seek-safe zoom keyframe for it.

say_en.text: Make this image a slow Ken Burns pan and zoom.
say_en.note: Claude will generate move keyframes and verify they seek.

say_en.text: Check that all keyframes in this composition can seek.
say_en.note: Claude will run diagnostics and report back.
